arStrings.szText: (sighs) We have wandered this scorching hell for hours, yet I can find no sign of this “vault.” My guide is ready to drag me back to Caldeum. To pack it in and go back to my country, but I cannot. There is nothing for me there.
We spied a wagon train on the next dune. I believe they might be Vecin—wandering mystics, featured in many of Jered’s tales. Some of my favorites, in fact.
My guide says they ride East to “peddle their witchcraft" to the swampfolk. I will see for myself.
